message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the charge(s). Facts: employer hired temporary workers to make advertisement board, no construction qualification, did not require safety helmets, safety ropes. Worker fell from scaffold, died. Safety production supervision identified the responsible person as the head of advertising engineering department, i.e., the defendant. This is a production safety accident causing death due to failure to implement safety measures. According to correction rules: "When the factual narrative describes a production‑safety accident in which the defendant’s failure to implement required safety measures directly caused a death, the correct charge is the crime of ‘重大责任事故’ rather". So charge: 重大责任事故 (major responsibility accident). Also possibly other charges? He was charged by prosecutor. No mention of fraud, contract, etc. So only that. So output single charge.

Thus JSON with reasoning and final answer.
